About us:
NamiTech is a leading tech startup in Vietnam focused on AI applications. With strong support from FPT Corporation and Thiên Việt Investment Fund (TVS), we're
committed to developing world-class AI technology products for both local and global markets. Our lineup includes noise cancellation, voice biometrics, speech recognition,
sentiment analysis, and natural language processing (NLP). Backed by a diverse team of experts and a culture of teamwork, we aim to become Vietnam's next unicorn,
expanding our AI Made in Vietnam products worldwide.

Responsibilities:
Conduct customer discovery sessions to assess current systems/processes and identify pain points.
Gather and validate requirements with internal stakeholders; ensure feasibility and propose solutions.
Prepare and deliver solution demos and presentations to customer teams and leadership.
Lead bidding activities: write proposals, build compliance matrix, and coordinate BOM/pricing.
Key Responsibilities:
Consulting & Discovery: Meet with customers directly to assess the current state of systems and business processes (Contact Center, related systems, and
IT infrastructure). Identify pain points and propose suitable solutions.
Requirements Analysis: Work closely with the PO, SRE, BA, and other stakeholders to clarify customer requirements, validate feasibility between customer expectations and system capabilities, and provide appropriate recommendations.
Solution Presentation: Develop and deliver highly persuasive solution demos and presentation decks to customer teams and leadership.
Bidding / Tendering: Lead the creation of proposal documents, build the technical compliance matrix, and coordinate with internal teams to finalize pricing and BOM (Bill of Materials).

Qualifications & Skills:
Experience: Minimum 3- 5 years of experience in Presales or Software/IT Systems Solution Consulting for B2B/Enterprise customers.
Preferred: Experience in Contact Center, CRM, or AI NLP domains.
Soft skills: Excellent presentation and negotiation skills; strong ability to “translate” technical concepts into business language.
Knowledge: Solid understanding of AI models (LLMs, NLP), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure), and operational business systems.
Strong task management skills; able to work under high pressure with a proactive mindset.
Eager to learn; strong self-learning ability and effective information research skills to support work.
Good English proficiency.
